```{=html}
<style>
.dash-topbar {
  display: flex;

.dash-topbar a {
  font-family: var(--font-label);

.dash-stats {
  display: flex;

  margin: 1rem 0 2rem;
}

  flex: 1;

.dash-stat-num {

}

}

  width: 100%;

  color: var(--ink);
  background: transparent;
  border: none;

</style>

<div class="dash-topbar"><a href="http://localhost:8501" target="_blank">AIコックピットを開く ↗</a></div>
<div id="dash-root"></div>

<script>
(async function () {
  const rootEl = document.getElementById("dash-root");

  async function get(path) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(path, { cache: "no-store" });
      return res.ok ? await res.json() : null;
    } catch (e) { return null; }
  }

  const [data, shelf, aiListRaw] = await Promise.all([
    get("library.json"), get("shelf.json"), get("ai_list.json"),
  ]);
  const aiList = new Set(aiListRaw || []);

  if (!data) {
    rootEl.innerHTML =
      '<div class="dash-empty">まだデータがありません。デスクトップの「研究ダッシュボード.command」' +
      'から起動すると、Zotero（Econ.json）の内容が自動で読み込まれます。</div>';
    return;
  }

  // shelf_state.json のステータス（未読/読中/読了）を正規化
  const SHELF_MAP = { "未読": "to-read", "読中": "reading", "読書中": "reading", "読了": "done" };
  const SKIP_TYPES = new Set(["attachment", "note", "annotation"]);

  // BetterBibTeX JSON ({items: [...]}) と CSL JSON ([...]) の両対応
  const items = (Array.isArray(data) ? data : data.items || [])
    .filter((it) => !SKIP_TYPES.has(it.itemType))
    .map((it) => {
      const tags = (it.tags || []).map((t) => (typeof t === "string" ? t : t.tag));
      const creators = it.creators
        ? it.creators.map((c) => c.lastName || c.name).filter(Boolean)
        : (it.author || []).map((a) => a.family || a.literal).filter(Boolean);
      const year =
        (it.date || "").match(/\d{4}/)?.[0] ||
        it.issued?.["date-parts"]?.[0]?.[0] || "";
      const ck = it.citationKey || it.id || "";
      const entry = shelf && shelf[ck];
      const status =
        (entry && SHELF_MAP[entry.status]) ||
        ["to-read", "reading", "done"].find((s) => tags.includes(s)) ||
        "to-read";
      return {
        title: it.title || "(no title)",
        authors: creators.join(", "),
        year: String(year),
        venue: it.publicationTitle || it["container-title"] || "",
        tags: tags.filter((t) => !SHELF_MAP[t] && !["to-read", "reading", "done"].includes(t)),
        status,
        star: !!(entry && entry.star),
        hasAI: aiList.has(ck),
        added: it.dateAdded || it.accessed || "",
        citekey: ck,
        url: it.url || it.URL || (it.DOI ? "https://doi.org/" + it.DOI : ""),
      };
    });

  // ★を先頭に、あとは追加日の新しい順
  items.sort((a, b) =>
    (b.star - a.star) || (b.added || "").localeCompare(a.added || ""));

  const STATUSES = [
    ["to-read", "未読"],
    ["reading", "読書中"],
    ["done", "読了"],
    ["all", "すべて"],
  ];
  let activeStatus = "to-read";
  let query = "";

  function count(s) {
    return s === "all" ? items.length : items.filter((i) => i.status === s).length;
  }

  function esc(t) {
    return String(t).replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;");
  }

  function render() {
    const visible = items.filter((i) => {
      const okStatus = activeStatus === "all" || i.status === activeStatus;
      const q = query.toLowerCase();
      const okQuery =
        !q || (i.title + " " + i.authors + " " + i.venue).toLowerCase().includes(q);
      return okStatus && okQuery;
    });

    const stats = STATUSES.map(
      ([key, label]) =>
        '<div class="dash-stat' + (key === activeStatus ? " active" : "") +
        '" data-status="' + key + '">' +
        '<div class="dash-stat-num">' + count(key) + "</div>" +
        '<div class="dash-stat-label">' + label + "</div></div>"
    ).join("");

    const list = visible.length
      ? visible.map((i) => {
          const meta = [i.authors, i.year, i.venue].filter(Boolean).join(" ・ ");
          const zoteroLink = i.citekey
            ? '<a href="zotero://select/items/@' + esc(i.citekey) + '">Zotero</a>'
            : "";
          const urlLink = i.url ? '<a href="' + esc(i.url) + '" target="_blank">原文</a>' : "";
          const statusLabel = { "to-read": "未読", reading: "読書中", done: "読了" }[i.status];
          const tags =
            '<span class="dash-tag st-' + i.status + '">' + statusLabel + "</span>" +
            (i.hasAI ? '<span class="dash-tag ai-badge">AI要約あり</span>' : "") +
            i.tags.slice(0, 4).map((t) => '<span class="dash-tag">' + esc(t) + "</span>").join("");
          return (
            '<div class="dash-item">' +
            '<div class="dash-item-title">' +
            (i.star ? '<span class="dash-star">★</span>' : "") +
            (i.url ? '<a href="' + esc(i.url) + '" target="_blank">' + esc(i.title) + "</a>" : esc(i.title)) +
            "</div>" +
            '<div class="dash-item-meta">' + esc(meta) + "</div>" +
            '<div class="dash-item-tags">' + tags +
            '<span class="dash-links">' + zoteroLink + urlLink + "</span></div></div>"
          );
        }).join("")
      : '<div class="dash-empty">該当する論文はありません。</div>';

    rootEl.innerHTML =
      '<div class="dash-stats">' + stats + "</div>" +
      '<input class="dash-search" type="search" placeholder="タイトル・著者・掲載誌で検索" value="' +
      esc(query) + '">' + list;

    rootEl.querySelectorAll(".dash-stat").forEach((el) =>
      el.addEventListener("click", () => {
        activeStatus = el.dataset.status;
        render();
      })
    );
    const search = rootEl.querySelector(".dash-search");
    search.addEventListener("input", (e) => {
      query = e.target.value;
      render();
    });
  }

  render();
})();
</script>
```
